context.label: Passover, covenant, and table before the night

observations.body: The LORD appoints the month, lamb, blood sign, roasted meal, hurried posture, memorial day, and seven days of unleavened bread before the plague passes through Egypt.
observations.label: Passover is appointed before departure

observations.body: The passage presents Eating in haste and keeping a memorial as the scene's observable response or movement.
observations.label: Eating in haste and keeping a memorial

observations.body: The passage places The LORD passes over the marked houses beside Eating in haste and keeping a memorial.
observations.label: The LORD passes over the marked houses

payload.posture: Read Exodus 12:1–20 as one movement in the Last Supper, keeping the passage's actions, setting, sequence, and limits visible.
payload.tension: The passage states the LORD appoints the month, lamb, blood sign, roasted meal, hurried posture, memorial day, and seven days of unleavened bread before the plague passes through Egypt. It does not by itself supply every cause or later interpretation of this part of the Last Supper.
payload.title: Passover is appointed before departure
